messages:
morgan: Heads-up — I pushed a config-only rollout to canary: lower global batching window to 6ms, reduce per-tenant concurrency floor from 8 -> 6, add a soft TTL on routing cache entries (30s), and enable a circuit-breaker that trips on 5xx-rate > 0.8% for 1m. Rolling to 5% canary now.

deploybot: deploy queued: config-only, change_id=cfg-2026-03-21-09, targets=canary(5%), author=morgan. ETA 60s.

ash: ack. list of metrics we'll watch? p99 latency, 5xx rate, queue length? any memory/KV cache impact?

morgan: yeah p99, p50, 5xx-rate, p99-serving-time, kvcache-miss-rate, and per-host goroutine/threads. Also watch batch_size distribution (expect smaller batches).

ash: +1. Canary window: 30m and automatic rollback threshold if 5xx-rate increases by +0.4pp vs baseline or p99 increases >30%.

sasha: note: circuit really important for routing fallback. Make sure fallback route is pinned to model v2.1-compatible variant. If fallback uses older kv schema, we must pin.

morgan: pinned fallback to model:v2.1-compat in config. Routing policy snippet:```yaml
routing_policy:
  primary: fastpath-v3
  fallback: model-v2.1-compat
  circuit_breaker: {error_percent: 0.8, window_s: 60}
  ttl_seconds: 30
  batching_ms: 6
  tenant_concurrency_floor: 6
```

devon: deploybot shows canary started. tagging on-call: @devon for early check. Please run the smoke script at +5m and +15m: `scripts/smoke-check.sh --canary cfg-2026-03-21-09`.

deploybot: canary rollout started -> 5% traffic (10 hosts). change_id=cfg-2026-03-21-09. To rollback: `deploybot rollback cfg-2026-03-21-09` or unpin via console.

eva: quick question — lowering batching window may increase token cost due to smaller batches. Was cost delta modeled?

morgan: yes modeled ~+2.1% cost on short seq workloads, negligible for long seq. We accepted for latency gains.

devon: on-call will watch grafana dashboard `infra/serve/config-rollouts` and alert if alerting rule `cfg_canary_error_spike` fires. I'll post snapshots to this thread every 10m.

sasha: one more ops note: set the graceful_drain timeout to 45s across canary hosts so they don't pile up.

morgan: done. added `graceful_drain_seconds: 45` to change.

ash: quick rollback playbook if threshold hit: 1) flip canary to 0% via deploybot, 2) unpin routing TTL/batching change if necessary, 3) redeploy previous config-only (cfg-previous), 4) open incident if rollback >2 minutes.

devon: smoke at +5m: p99 ~ 120ms, 5xx-rate 0.03% (baseline 0.02%). batch_size median dropped from 18 -> 9 as expected. posting screenshots.

morgan: good. leave canary to 30m then ramp to 25% if stable for 30m.

deploybot: canary update: 15m passed, stable. 5% -> 25% ramping in 2 minutes.

eva: FYI billing team asked to be notified if cost delta > +3% for non-exempt tenants. we'll keep an eye.

ash: note for release notes: call this change "routing cache TTL + batching window optimization" and mention cost note. I'll draft blurb after ramp complete.

devon: 25m checkpoint: p99 122ms, 5xx-rate 0.04% (within threshold), kvcache-miss-rate +1.2pp. continuing to monitor.

sasha: small observation — one host showed elevated CPU at 85% and slightly higher queue length. I cordoned host id=host-22 and let deploybot drain it. keep an eye.

morgan: ack. cordon made, canary still within thresholds.

devon: 40m mark: alert rule `cfg_canary_error_spike` fired briefly at 38m but resolved. p99 spiked to 185ms then recovered to 125ms. I'm leaning to continue ramp but watch for recurrence.

morgan: agree. hold at 25% for 20 more minutes, not ramp to 100% until a full hour stable.

ash: if we see another resolved spike, consider soft rollback (unpin batching_ms -> 8, keep TTL). Less disruptive.

morgan: noted. will prepare quick-change with batching_ms=8 as a patch.

deploybot: canary complete 1h, stable. final rollout plan: ramp to 50% over 15m -> 100% over 30m unless rollback triggers. Will create a tracked change in release board.

sasha: please attach the config diff to the release board and include the rollback playbook.

morgan: attached diff and playbook. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

devon: final note: create post-deploy ticket to re-evaluate cost impact with real telemetry in 48h.

morgan: done. closing thread once ramp completes.
